page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5g.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type includes 3839 GB of bundled local SSD storage, which provides high-capacity local data access. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting steady data transfer rates for distributed environments. No graphics processing units are included in this hardware configuration.

The integration of high-capacity local SSD storage alongside a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio offers high resource density, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring substantial local storage without the overhead of external storage attachments. This configuration is suitable for relational databases, NoSQL data stores, large-scale file systems, and general-purpose enterprise applications that demand high-throughput local disk I/O and dedicated compute resources.
